questions.subject: DATA_SCIENCE
questions.topic: Why distance-based methods need a common scale
questions.stem: A field biologist scales measurements before computing Euclidean distances.

questions.explanation: Euclidean distance is sensitive to scale. Large-range features dominate otherwise. Scaling equalizes contribution.
